title: SDD oracle configuration (specs/fixtures/oracle.config.json)
description: How oracle.cjs reaches an implementation. Machine-specific values come from environment variables via ${VAR} / ${VAR:-default}, so the frozen file is identical for every build.

targets.description: Named builds. 'default' is graded by `oracle run`; 'a' and 'b' are compared by `oracle diff`.

defaultSetup.description: Hooks run before every case unless the case sets `setup`.

sql.description: Runs one SQL query. Arguments may contain {{sql}}. Must print the result rows as a JSON array on stdout.

buildEnv.description: Frozen environment every graded build is started with (SPEC §12 values for oracle runs, e.g. shortened TTLs per profile ENV-3). Print with `oracle.cjs env`.

observedHeaders.description: Response headers SPEC declares contractual beyond the profile's HTTP-10 set (lowercase). `oracle diff` compares only contractual headers.

variablePaths.description: Declared degrees of freedom: JSONPath-like patterns ($..id, $.data[*].created_at) whose values may differ between builds in `oracle diff` (type must still match). Must mirror SPEC.md §Equivalence Boundary.

env.description: Extra env for hooks, adapters and run steps of this target.
